name: New City Fellowship
pastor: Rev. Daryl Wattley (Senior Pastor, installed Sept 2025)

score_notes.christology: PCA affiliation means full Nicene orthodoxy; Christ as only Savior is foundational.

score_notes.gender: PCA male-only teaching/ruling elders preserved. Church has two deaconesses (unordained service role, permissible within PCA variance). No ordained women. Complementarian PCA polity intact.

Daryl Wattley installed as Senior Pastor Sept 2025 — first African-American ordained in PCA Heritage Presbytery. Elder body: 9 male elders (Burgee, Kessler, Clarke, McCorkle, Erdelatz, Murdoc, Rivers, Quartuccio, Winters). score_notes.cultural: No DEI/CRT framing found. Cross-cultural emphasis is missional ('every nation, tribe, people, and language') — explicitly tied to Great Commission, not social justice ideology.

score_notes.mens_discipleship: Sunday School classes for all ages, care groups — no standalone men's discipleship ministry confirmed.
score_notes.denominational: PCA — one of the strongest conservative Reformed denominations in the U.S. James River Presbytery accountability. Full Westminster Confession alignment.
